column3: Send button: requester is the ChatScreen, so after Escape the Send never settles and the Console pump never runs again; count 2 because ChatScreen defines on_button_pressed twice (the earlier def is shadowed). reviewed 2026-09-30 (TASK-33621.13 triage): REAL freeze, NOT via NoActiveWorker -- a Send needing hook consent awaits request_hook_review, which pushes with callback= and awaits a future that callback resolves, but Textual queues the callback on the requester pump via call_next and the requester is the pump doing the awaiting (PR #2922, 2bce8ffa0f+aed1b13501). Not fixed here: the fix must also move the Enter send off the app pump, whose app.call_later scheduling tests pin. Follow-up: 'Console Send hook review deadlocks its dispatching pump'.
